title: The Salt Margin Where Knowing Ends

features.name: salt shelf
features.desc-on-touch: Crystalline ledges where water has decided not to flow—each crystal a moment where the map forgot how to continue.

features.name: horizon dissolution
features.desc-on-touch: Where the shore learns there is no shore anymore—the boundary between land and water has stopped maintaining itself.

features.name: tide marker
features.desc-on-touch: A spire of salt that marks where the water was knowing and where it became only ocean—the last place the map applied.

features.name: driftwood archive
features.desc-on-touch: Wood that has learned too many languages—each grain records a current, a route, a way that was forgotten.

features.name: salt-stained ledger
features.desc-on-touch: Pages that catalogue routes the ocean has already unmade—records of where roads used to be convinced they were going.

inscription: at the margin where salt ends and water begins there is nothing left that knows the difference
